comparison.objective: Mount the final section of a bicycle tire bead into its rim while preserving the tube and acceptable valve alignment.
comparison.physical_skill: Localized compliant pressing, creating bead slack through the drop center, coordinated holding and rolling, and avoiding pinch damage.
comparison.success_condition: Bead is seated, valve alignment and hand clearance meet the versioned rubric, and no tube-damage proxy or real leak occurs; partial credit covers drop-center progress or an incomplete final state. No granular recovery threshold exists.
comparison.reason: Although both involve orientation-sensitive contact and possible bridging, tire mounting tests deformation-like bead seating around a rim, not separating mixed free bodies through apertures while retaining workpieces.
